en.headline: 12 commits, 2 issues opened, 1 discussion started on 2026-10-16
en.summary: On 2026-10-16, `sogeisetsu` recorded **12 own commits** across two repositories, plus 14 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` (7 commits), the work centered on documentation and knowledge-base scaffolding: adding an `AGENTS.md` with a note about the origin remote, creating a `knowledge/` base for Git & GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, generalizing the knowledge section from Git/GitHub-specific to "various knowledge", making knowledge supplementation a default action in the agents doc, and archiving OpenCode V2 distribution/architecture/auth notes plus Windows path pitfalls and oh-my-opencode-slim / hosted OpenCode findings. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` (5 commits), the daily-report CLI gained a `--force` flag that skips the comment-count snapshot freeze and documents the backfill effect when re-running a closed date; `--force` was extended to also re-fetch the finalized-day comment snapshot; candidate filtering by `updated_at` inside the window was removed; comment-count semantics and target retrieval were tightened per review feedback; and a +08 early-morning reply-collection bug was fixed while adding comment counts to Issue/PR rows.

zh.headline: 2026-10-16：12 次提交、2 个 issue、1 个讨论
zh.summary: 2026-10-16，`sogeisetsu` 在两个仓库中共完成 **12 次本人提交**，另有 14 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`（7 次）中，工作集中在文档与知识库搭建：新增 `AGENTS.md` 并注明 origin 远程，创建 `knowledge/` 目录用于 Git & GitHub 相关发现并附 Excalidraw 草图，将 knowledge 章节从 Git/GitHub 专用泛化为「各种知识」，把 knowledge 补充改为 agents 文档中的默认动作，并归档 OpenCode V2 分发/架构/认证笔记、Windows 路径坑以及 oh-my-opencode-slim 与托管 OpenCode 的实测知识。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`（5 次）中，日报 CLI 新增 `--force` 参数以跳过评论数快照冻结，并说明重跑已关闭日期的补录效应；`--force` 进一步扩展为同时重取定稿日的评论数快照；移除了候选条目按 `updated_at` 是否落在窗口内过滤的逻辑；按复审意见收紧了评论数口径与 target 检索；修复了 +08 凌晨漏采回复的问题，并在 Issue/PR 行显示评论数。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 上开出了两个 issue：#55785 "go: mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects every image (400)"（3 条评论，收到 `micahgerges` 与 `opencode-agent[bot]` 的回复）以及 #55772 "[FEATURE]: Windows desktop ships the CLI but there is no way to run it"（1 条评论，收到 `opencode-agent[bot]` 的回复）。另在 `openchamber/openchamber` 发起了 1 个讨论：#4982 "Share session archive state with OpenCode's own clients"，属于 Ideas 分类。当日无 PR、无 review、无 release，且各采集分区均未触及上限。
